_note: The War Room's What's New?! board (WhatsNewDialog). `current` is this build's version (project.godot application/config/version must match; validate_data checks). Releases newest first. An item is a line of text, or {"label", "text"} for a bold lead-in, with optional "items" indented under it. A release can carry a `note` {title, text, button, link}: a lit box under its version with a button that opens the link (0.2.2: the Discord is open). `next` is the What's Next?! roadmap: `updates` (kind "minor"/"major", when, items; no version number, it gets one when it ships) in planned order, then loose `items`. Text: Logan, 2026-10-14; the roadmap follows the one posted on Discord (Logan, 2026-10-15).

note.title: The Discord is open!
note.text: Come meet the other pilots, report bugs, share your builds and see what's coming next. You can join any time from the sign in the War Room.

items.label: New:
items.text: a Feedback button on every screen (it sends where you are, and the fight so far), and a Join the Discord! sign in the War Room.

items.label: Training:
items.text: a simulated mission at the Shipyard, clearer steps (where cards come from, how a fight is won, what a destroyed part means), and a Skip button in the corner.

items.label: Balance:
items.text: repair bays heal at most 75 HP, and Reroute can't turn a status into Disabled any more.

items.label: Combat:
items.text: High Five counts your attacks on its badge, Replay says it repeats your last hardpoint card, and every status says how long it lasts.

items.label: Salvage:
items.text: Show Mech now opens your whole mech and Cargo, with every part's cards on hover.

items.label: Protocols:
items.text: every protocol now does exactly what its card says. Coordinated Strike fires again (drop it on an enemy part), Loaded Dice can't be parried or dodged, Overlay no longer also does Zero Lock's job (it can be redirected, and later hits can miss), Heat Transfer only moves Heat you have, Bleed Off waits for a linked part to pay, Recall works alongside a Standby card, and Echo can take an enemy's Standby.

items.label: Fixes:
items.text: an enemy overheating no longer looks like damage to you, reactor passives light up their part, and the settings screen fits in release builds.

items.label: New intro:
items.text: a new Trismeg Studios intro screen.

items.label: Training:
items.text: the training run's coaching and the reward screen were reworked.

items.label: New Art!
items: Data Archives and Mining Grounds combat backgrounds
War Room stations: Directives, Pilot Log, Memorial Wall, Info Bay and Livery Bay
Snow and dust weather in combat

items.label: Balance:
items.text: tuned some deployment orders and enemy loadouts, and enemies no longer waste their own parts.

items.label: Combat:
items.text: hover an enemy part to see its cards. Enemies with nothing left to play retreat, and status effects have their own icons.

items.label: New:
items.text: name your War Room, a new run summary, and this What's New?! board.

releases.title: First Release
items: Added another card to every hardpoint and protocol.
Balanced every card to give each one more trade-offs and you more options.
Enemies now have their own strategies and play more varied turns.
New icons for enemy intents and statuses

items.label: Research Runs:
items.text: a new mission type to unlock new mechs

items: More parts to unlock as you play
Steam Cloud saves, so your progress follows you between PCs

items.label: The Steam store page goes live:
Backline Blitz:
items.text: elites and bosses only, for bigger Chip rewards

items.label: Threat levels:
items.text: optional harder modifiers for more Chips

items.label: A new sector:
items.text: new location, enemies, events and battlegrounds

items: Oct 26 – Nov 8: the dev is on vacation, so no updates. Keep the feedback coming!
Week of Dec 28: holiday break, fixes only.
And much more, including your ideas!
